summary: The no_valid_comparison closure stands. All 77 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and all five computations reproduced. BioSample confirms six male Gr3 dual-agonist libraries and eight male vehicle controls. The published RNA results cover peripheral tissues, and the hypothalamic panels measure protein after a single dose. The corrected proposal records a treatment-label conflict affecting 48 peripheral libraries outside the registered contrast. [Study and source data](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10427-5) · [BioSample records showing the conflict](https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=biosample&id=53543136,53543158&retmode=xml)
openIssues: The figure workbook and BioSample assign opposite treatments to all 24 displayed Gr2 libraries and all 24 displayed Gr4 libraries. Both sources agree on Gr3 and vehicle.
GEO reports seven treatment days and the publication reports 12 for peripheral RNA. The hypothalamic specimen records omit dosing duration.
